article.intro: This **Minecraft name from your name** generator turns your first name or nickname into Minecraft usernames: SamTheCreeper, DiamondSam, LilSam. It cleans your name to letters, numbers and underscores and builds it into usernames in five styles, all within Minecraft's 16-character limit.

sections.heading: How the Minecraft name maker builds your name
sections.content:
The generator takes your name, removes anything Minecraft won't allow, and adds a Minecraft word before or after it.

  • It cleans your name first. Minecraft usernames only allow letters, numbers and underscores, so spaces and accents are taken out and the result is kept short enough to add a word.
  • Then it adds a Minecraft word before or after it: a mob (PiglinSam, Sam_Wolf), an ore or tool (NetheriteSam), a cool word, a cute word or a joke (NoobSam).
  • Every result fits the 3 to 16 character limit, so you can use it straight away.

sections.heading: Tips for a username based on your name
sections.content:
A username based on your name is easy for friends to remember, but keep it to a first name or nickname.

  • Try a nickname as well as your full name: a short name leaves room for a longer word.
  • Not keen on your real name online? Use a nickname or an initial instead. It's safer, especially for younger players.
  • If it's taken, try the underscore version or add a number.

For usernames that don't use your name at all, try the Minecraft Username Generator.

For everything else in Minecraft, see all the Minecraft name generators.

More for your Minecraft world: pet names and world names.

faqs.question: What's my Minecraft name?
faqs.answer: Type your name or nickname into the box and pick a style: you'll get a list of usernames built from it, like SamTheCreeper or DiamondSam.

faqs.question: Should I use my real name in Minecraft?
faqs.answer: A first name or nickname is usually fine, but don't add your surname, age or where you live. Younger players are safer with a nickname.

faqs.question: Why has my name been shortened?
faqs.answer: Minecraft usernames can only be 16 characters long, so long names are trimmed to leave room for the Minecraft word.

faqs.question: How do I make a Minecraft username from my name?
faqs.answer: Type your first name or nickname into the box, pick a style (mob, miner, cool, funny or cute) and generate. Every result fits Minecraft's 3 to 16 character rule.
